headline: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
context: Over a billion people worldwide have livers with excess fat, which can lead to a host of medical problems. Researchers think AI tools can spot the condition—and help stop it—early enough to save lives.
